name: MRE11 double strand break repair nuclease

function.text: MRE11 encodes double-strand break repair protein MRE11. Annotated molecular activities include nuclease activity and 3'-5' exonuclease activity. It participates in DNA repair and homologous recombination.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include ataxia-telangiectasia-like disorder 1 (autosomal recessive). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Somatic MRE11 alterations have been reported in ovarian carcinoma. Somatic involvement in a tumor is distinct from the separately assessed, refuted hereditary breast/ovarian cancer-predisposition claims.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
